name: Moltres
description: It’s one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

moves.name: Gust
moves.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Leer
moves.description: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers the Defense stat.

moves.name: Ember
moves.description: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

moves.name: Wing Attack
moves.description: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Incinerate
moves.description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with fire. If a Pokémon is holding a certain item, such as a Berry, the item becomes burned up and unusable.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

moves.name: Heat Wave
moves.description: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave those Pokémon with a burn.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves. It lowers the power of Water-type moves.

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Burn Up
moves.description: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.

moves.name: Sky Attack
moves.description: A second-turn attack move where critical hits land more easily. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Fly
moves.description: The user flies up into the sky and then strikes its target on the next turn.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

moves.name: Fire Spin
moves.description: The target becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for four to five turns.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. It raises the Sp. Def stat of Rock types.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.description: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves. It lowers the power of Water-type moves.

moves.name: Heat Wave
moves.description: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave those Pokémon with a burn.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.description: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.description: This attack move varies in power and type depending on the weather.

moves.name: Overheat
moves.description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Flare Blitz
moves.description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.description: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Mystical Fire
moves.description: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Burning Jealousy
moves.description: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

moves.name: Dual Wingbeat
moves.description: The user slams the target with its wings. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.name: Scorching Sands
moves.description: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.
